title: Memory Body Text 1
description: The Bebe Miller Company works with memory as a resource for improvisation in performance. One way they do this is through a state they have devised called Redux. In a Redux, they actively work to recall a piece of set choreography they have performed in the past and reference aspects of it in the new performance.
